summary: Kerb lined with parked cars, backing onto trees and lawn; no homes.

drivers.seclusion: Trees and lawn on the west side, river bush to the east; nearest buildings are university, 44 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars are parked nose-to-tail along this kerb in the Esri image, so there is room.
drivers.traffic: Campus riverside road; light at night, some noise from the bridge to the north.
drivers.convention: Many cars park on both sides; a van would not stand out.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs near the line; check their position
Low-lying: about 6.4 m, 152 m from Brisbane River
Noise from Go Between Bridge to the north
sun_shade: Tree shade from the west and overhead in places; open to the east over the river.

best_section.where: West kerb, north of the large roofed hall by the river road
